profile.reading: This facility is attributed in the registry to DataBank. DataBank Ltd. was established in 2005 in a historic former Federal Reserve Bank building in downtown Dallas, Texas, that had been converted to a data center in 1999, per DataBank own corporate history page fetched this session. DataBank was acquired in July 2016 by a group of investors led by DigitalBridge, per that same page. DataBank own history page also lists a series of acquisitions expanding its footprint, three Salt Lake City area data centers from C7 Data Centers plus facilities in Cleveland and Pittsburgh from 365 Data Centers in January 2017, Lightbound, an Indianapolis based provider, in December 2018, United States and United Kingdom data center assets from zColo in December 2020, and four Houston area data centers from CyrusOne for 670 million dollars in January 2022. A trade press article fetched this session, from pe-insights.com, reports that DigitalBridge agreed to sell a 27 percent fully diluted equity stake in DataBank to Swiss Life Asset Management and EDF Invest for about 1.2 billion dollars, expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2022, reducing DigitalBridge own stake to about 15.5 percent and yielding DigitalBridge about 230 million dollars in cash proceeds. DataBank own history page states the company now operates more than 65 data centers across more than 27 markets. The operator own Northern Virginia market overview page, fetched this session, describes this facility as IAD1, on the Ashburn Campus, and gives its address as 21635 Red Rum Drive, Ashburn, VA 20147, with 9.9 MW of critical IT load and 85,330 IT square feet.
